requirement: The motor shall not catch fire or create a safety hazard under overload conditions.
requirement_summary: Motor must not fire or create hazard under overload conditions

evidence_required.description: UL 2849 motor overload test report showing no fire or safety hazard

remediation: Ensure motor passes UL 2849 overload test without fire or safety hazard. Verify motor protection circuits are properly designed.

requirement: The motor shall not catch fire or create a safety hazard under locked rotor conditions.
requirement_summary: Motor must not fire or create hazard under locked rotor conditions

evidence_required.description: UL 2849 motor locked rotor test report showing no fire or safety hazard

remediation: Ensure motor passes UL 2849 locked rotor test without fire or safety hazard. Verify controller can detect and respond to locked rotor conditions.

requirement: The motor controller shall have overcurrent protection and overtemperature protection functions that automatically cut off or limit output under abnormal conditions.
requirement_summary: Controller must have overcurrent and overtemperature auto-protection

evidence_required.description: Controller specification sheet documenting overcurrent and overtemperature protection functions
UL 2849 component fault test report verifying controller protection functions

remediation: Implement overcurrent and overtemperature protection in the motor controller that automatically cuts off or limits output under abnormal conditions per UL 2849.

requirement: Under 15 USC §2085(2), a “low-speed electric bicycle” shall have fully operable pedals and an electric motor of less than 750W (1 hp), with a maximum speed of ≤20 mph (32 km/h) on a paved level surface when powered solely by the motor. Class 1: pedal-assist only, motor stops at 20mph. Class 2: throttle-assist, motor stops at 20mph. Class 3: pedal-assist only, motor stops at 28mph. All classes must have motor <750W.
requirement_summary: E-bike: motor <750W; Class 1/2 ≤20mph, Class 3 ≤28mph; must have operable pedals

evidence_required.description: Motor specification sheet showing rated power (must be <750W)
Maximum speed test report with 170 lb rider on paved level surface under motor power only

remediation: Ensure motor rated power is below 750W and maximum speed under motor-only power does not exceed 20 mph per §1512.2(b)(2).
